title: Baa Juice Blue Raspberry Bubblegum Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Blue Raspberry Bubblegum Shortfill blends the sharp tang of Blue Raspberry with the playful sweetness of Bubblegum. The combination delivers a fruity-sweet inhale with a nostalgic edge, while the high-VG mix ensures a smooth, flavourful vape with thick clouds. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills are crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, ensuring every puff carries a vivid, long-lasting taste that stays satisfying from first draw to last.
